articles.title: Aston Villa to take legal action against Jamie Carragher for ‘unacceptable insults’
articles.summary: Villa chair announces plan on social media. Carragher said club will ‘never be Man United’ Aston Villa have announced plans to take legal action against Jamie Carragher following his “unacceptable insults” about the club and its supporters.
body: Carragher told Villa fans to “shut the fuck up” after facing criticism for suggesting Unai Emery should consider taking the Manchester United job. Villa responded on Friday evening with a statement on X signed by their chair, Nassef Sawiris.

“Aston Villa will initiate legal action against Jamie Carragher for his unacceptable insults about the club and its fans,” the statement said. “Aston Villa will not allow anyone to stop our ascension in English and European football. Nassef Sawiris, chairman.”

Former Liverpool defender Carragher made his remarks on the Stick to Football podcast while discussing the prospect of Emery replacing Michael Carrick at Old Trafford. The 48-year-old Sky Sports pundit argued there was a hierarchy in football, saying “Aston Villa will never be Man United”.

“I’m not trying to annoy Villa fans but there is a chain in football, whether you like it or not,” said Carragher. “So Real Madrid will take Man United’s best player, they’ll take [Cristiano] Ronaldo. There’s very few above United, the same with Liverpool.

articles.title: Red Roses put defeats behind them by crushing USA to extend 35-year streak
articles.summary: USA 12-55 England. Claudia Moloney-MacDonald runs in four tries. England have seen a lot of records crumble around them in this WXV Global Series but the world champions were not going to let a 35-year winning streak go against the USA.
body: The USA headed into the match in good form with five consecutive wins, including victories over Wales and Ireland, and their No 8 Freda Tafuna has been one of the standouts across all of the teams during the WXV. However, England were able to contain the bright spark and despite good performances from Alev Kelter and Hope Rogers, the hosts did not have enough firepower.

There were two key elements to England’s win: Claudia Moloney-MacDonald and a strong second-half performance from the front row. The wing Moloney-MacDonald may have been dropped from the matchday 23 against Canada last time out but she responded perfectly with four tries. It will be the exact retort John Mitchell would have wanted and the head coach praised the Exeter star afterwards for her consistency. Breaks by players such as Maud Muir gave the visitors the extra few percentages they needed.

articles.title: Moloney-MacDonald stars as Red Roses return to winning ways with USA thrashing
articles.summary: England's Red Roses responded to shock back-to-back defeats in Canada with a crushing 55-12 WXV Global Series victory over the USA in New Jersey, returning to winning ways.
body: John Mitchell's side entered the contest off the back of losing two Tests in a row for the first time in a decade, and having lost their 41-Test, four-year unbeaten run in Toronto.
A competitive first half against the USA saw 10 points in it at half-time, but the second half proved largely one-way traffic as England's superiority showed.

In all, the Red Roses scored nine tries through wing Claudia Moloney-MacDonald (four), centre Meg Jones, wing Mia Venner, replacement hooker Bryony Field and back-rows Maddie Feaunati and Sadia Kabeya.

The USA scored two tries through loosehead prop Hope Rogers and replacement back Kate Zackary, but shipped three second-half tries in nine minutes with prop Mona Tupou in the sin-bin due to repeat scrum penalties.

articles.title: Alex de Minaur hits career milestone in Vienna to book semi-final date with Zverev
articles.summary: World No 10 defeats Matteo Berrettini 7-6 (7-4) 6-2 in quarter-final. 27-year-old becomes ninth Australian man to reach 350 tour-level wins. Alex de Minaur has enjoyed a landmark 350th tour-level win of his career at the Vienna Open, downing an old rival to set up a semi-final date with the world…
body: Australia’s main man defeated Matteo Berrettini, the Italian he’s had plenty of trouble with down the years, for the second successive year in the quarter-final of the ATP 500 event at the Wiener Stadthalle.

Not only did his 7-6 (7-4) 6-2 triumph set “Demon” up for a third duel in just over a month with Zverev on Saturday but it boosted his bid to reach the season-ending men’s championship, the ATP Finals, which still lies in the balance.

World No 10 de Minaur found a way to draw first blood in a tight first stanza after saving a set point at 5-6, going on to take control of the tiebreak when the Italian, almost criminally, plonked a simple put-away into the net.

De Minaur crucially saved a couple of break points at the start of the next set and cashed in by himself breaking Berrettini for the first time in the next game when the Italian produced an embarrassing air-shot when faced with a straightforward smash.

articles.title: Xabi Alonso rules out January loan move for Chelsea winger Estêvão Willian
articles.summary: ‘No discussions about that … Everyone has to be ready’ Brazilian has started only twice in 11 games this season. Xabi Alonso has ruled out a January move for Estêvão Willian but has said the Chelsea youngster must adapt to his style of play before earning a regular spot in the team.
body: The debate around Estêvão’s role gathered momentum this week, with the noise growing after the 19-year-old watched as an unused substitute as Alonso’s side lost to Liverpool on penalties in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday. The Brazilian became an instant hit with Chelsea fans after joining from Palmeiras last year and there are fears that the winger could look to leave after starting twice in 11 games in all competitions this season.

Yet while Estêvão is having a tougher time during his second year in English football, Alonso insisted that the Brazil international is part of his plans and will not be loaned out to get more games in January.

“No discussions about that,” Alonso said. “It’s no secret that all players want to be on the pitch. When any of them haven’t had enough minutes because of my decision, I have to take the responsibility for that. But everyone has to be ready because in any game they could be important. Este, his training and his attitude has been good.”

articles.title: England see off USA to return to winning ways
articles.summary: England's Red Roses return to winning ways, but without entirely vanquishing doubts over their position at the top of the women's game, as they see off the United States.
body: England's Red Roses returned to winning ways, but without entirely vanquishing doubts over their position at the top of the women's game, as they saw off a spirited United States in New Jersey.
England started steadily enough with wing Claudia Moloney-MacDonald crossing twice in the first 12 minutes, her second coming via a looping mis-pass from fly-half Holly Aitchison.
However the United States, who were obliterated 69-7 in the opening match of England's march to the Rugby World Cup last year, stuck in the contest far longer than they did that day in Sunderland.
The sixth-ranked underdogs were still snarling deep into the second half with one thunderous hit from Alev Kelter, hoisting and dumping England captain Meg Jones, rallying her team.

articles.title: Leclerc seals Mexico City practice double as Hamilton suffers technical issue
articles.summary: Charles Leclerc completed a Friday practice double at the Mexico City Grand Prix but Ferrari's strong showing was dampened by Lewis Hamilton suffering a technical issue.
body: Leclerc produced a time of 1:17.827s to finish just over a tenth clear of McLaren's Lando Norris and Mercedes' George Russell, with the British pair among 10 drivers who had earlier sat out the opening session to make way for rookie drivers.
Kimi Antonelli, who only needs to finish ninth in Sunday's race to become Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion, was a tenth down on his team-mate Russell in fourth.
Hamilton had been on course to go fastest as the session approached its midway point before suffering what appeared to be an engine issue in the final sector of his push lap, leaving him 11th.

He completed the lap but was then swiftly told by his engineer to pull over on track, ending his session early and denying him valuable information that his rivals were able to gather with their race simulations.

articles.title: Wrexham need honest self-assessment - Parkinson
articles.summary: Phil Parkinson says he will not shy away from any criticism that comes his way following Wrexham's 1-0 Championship loss to Sheffield United at Bramall Lane.
body: Phil Parkinson says Wrexham need to conduct some "honest" self-assessments on the back of their lacklustre display against Sheffield United.
The Red Dragons were significantly below par at Bramall Lane, particularly in the first half, as Ben Brereton Diaz's 30th-minute strike earned the Blades a 1-0 victory.
After the defeat in South Yorkshire, Parkinson urged his players to be individually "self-analytical".
"However you play, it's about 11 v 11, winning your individual duels and coming out on top of the player you're against," he told BBC Radio Wales.

articles.title: Sheff Utd win first league game against Wrexham in 44 years
articles.summary: Sheffield United shook off a 44-year hoodoo by beating Wrexham 1-0 in the Championship, winning against the Welsh side in the league for the first time since October 1982.
body: It is a fixture that is turning in to one of the great EFL contests, but after their two Championship matches last term produced 11 goals, this one registered just five shots on target.
The majority were for the Blades, with Brentford loanee Romelle Donovan central to much of the good attacking play, although it was Ben Brereton Diaz who decided it.
He turned home a saved effort from Jordan Ayew for his third goal in three appearances against Wrexham, having scored in both games against them for Derby last season.
Sheffield United should have had a penalty soon after after when Dominic Hyam fouled Harrison Burrows inside the area. However, the referee waved away the claims.

articles.title: Cox sets world record to win gold at Worlds
articles.summary: Great Britain's Kadeena Cox sets a new world record as she wins C4 1km gold at the Para-cycling Track World Championships in the Netherlands.
body: The 35-year-old crossed the line in 1 minute 9.545 seconds to win her seventh world title.
Cox faced a nervous wait as Tara Neyland took to the track afterwards in pursuit of a medal, but her Australian rival could not eclipse the Briton's time.
Cox, who is a five-time Paralympic gold medallist, was draped in a British flag by her team following victory as she joyously celebrated her first world title since 2024.
In the men's tandem B 1km time-trial, Britain's James Ball defended his title as he won gold alongside new partner Aaron Pope.

articles.title: ‘Forget the Picks,’ ‘Go All In’ — Super Bowl Champion Pressures Cowboys Owner Jerry Jones To Make Blockbuster Trade for 5-Time Pro Bowler
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys, currently second in the NFC East, have a lot to consider before the Nov. 10 trade deadline. After making deals for Joey Porter Jr. and Quinnen Williams, Dallas has already depleted its stockpile of future draft picks, leaving it with just four selections in the upcoming draft.
body: But should the Cowboys give up even more? Aqib Talib certainly thinks so. The Super Bowl-winning cornerback wants Dallas to pursue a five-time Pro Bowler, even if it means parting with more future first-round picks and setting back its long-term plans.
Speaking on the “Gridiron” podcast, Talib made Crosby his preferred choice to fix Dallas’ defensive problems.
“I think Jerry should stick to plan A. Go get Maxx Crosby, man,” Talib said.

He believes adding a player like Crosby could give the defense a much-needed jolt and give a frustrated locker room something to rally around. “He’ll bring great, just energy, revitalized energy to the defense,” Talib said.

articles.title: Chandler Smith Wins at Martinsville After Late Race Restart
articles.summary: Chandler Smith delivered when it mattered most, capturing the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series victory at Martinsville Speedway on Friday night. The Front Row Motorsports driver made a crucial move on a late restart to take control and secure the win in the Black’s Tire 200. Driving the No.
body: Driving the No. 38 Ford, Smith passed teammate Layne Riggs on the final restart and held on to claim another important victory in the 2026 season. Ben Rhodes finished second, while Riggs settled for third after leading much of the race’s late battle.

The closing laps provided the drama, with Smith taking advantage of his opportunity when the field lined up for the final restart. Riggs tried to protect the bottom lane, but Smith lined up to his outside and found the opening he needed to get past.
Once Smith moved ahead, he had the track position necessary to bring home the victory. The late pass proved decisive in a race where every position mattered.
Smith started third and gained two positions to reach Victory Lane. His win added another strong performance to a season in which he has remained a contender in the Truck Series.

articles.title: Furious Komatsu dismisses 'nonsense' reports of Bearman demanding £5m salary
articles.summary: Haas boss Ayao Komatsu has furiously dismissed reports claiming that contract extension talks with Oliver Bearman are being held up by the British driver demanding a £5m annual salary.
body: Both Bearman and Komatsu have expressed confidence in recent weeks that a deal will be done to extend the 21-year-old's current contract, which expires at the end of the 2026 season.

With Haas having already announced the signing of Bearman's fellow Ferrari junior Rafael Camara to replace Esteban Ocon next season, the lack of confirmation on his own future has led to speculation over what the issues are that are holding up the deal.
Asked on Friday at the Mexico City Grand Prix about claims that Bearman's financial demands are the main sticking point, Komatsu said: "I have no idea where that comes from.
"I've experienced this sometimes this season as well. People say there's no smoke without fire but really some people will invent a story.

articles.title: FC Barcelona’s Hansi Flick admits Harry Kane deserved Ballon d’Or, proud of Lamine Yamal
articles.summary: Former Bayern Munich head coach and current Barcelona boss Hansi Flick was asked about the Ballon d’Or discussion, with Harry Kane having taken home the prestigious individual award ahead of Barcelona’s Lamine Yamal.
body: Flick had no reservations about Kane being the deserving winner, while also making it clear that he believes Yamal has the quality to win the trophy himself in the future.
A classy response from Flick. Kane’s incredible performances and individual achievements made him a worthy winner, while Yamal still has plenty of time to put his own name on the trophy.
And coming from someone who knows Kane well from their time together at Bayern, Flick’s endorsement is another deserved bit of recognition for the Englishman’s extraordinary career.
